item.title: StepFun Unveils Step 5 Preview for Long-Horizon Agents
item.description: StepFun’s new 600-billion-parameter sparse model targets software, research and finance agents with a one-million-token context window.

item.title: Trump Announces AI Force and Plans for an AI Czar
item.description: The White House is adding a new AI Force label and considering a central AI czar as Washington pushes a more coordinated federal strategy.

item.title: ⚡ 15 quick hits — Morning edition, Sep 20
item.description: · Atlassian described automating root-cause analysis by linking metrics, logs, and traces into a unified diagnostic workflow.（InfoQ China） · U.S. daily AI use more than doubled in six months, according to new usage data reported by The Decoder.（The Decoder） · Kuaishou presented an architecture-evolution strategy for the AI era at QCon Shanghai, focusing on changes required by AI workloads.（InfoQ China） · A ScienceDiscovery interview described AI systems moving from answering questions toward conducting research across nanobodies, aircraft, and other domains.（InfoQ China） · Researchers trained simulated students that make realistic mistakes, helping AI tutors improve faster than with idealized learners.（The Decoder） · AI usage research, tutoring experiments, and new diagnostic tooling all point to AI moving from model demos into repeatable operational workflows.（The Decoder） · Lovart showcased a campaign turning classic art references into a new brand identity through generative design workflows.（X / Lovart AI） · OpenAI and Anthropic were reported to be postponing potential IPO plans, adding uncertainty to frontier-lab capital strategies.（The Decoder） · APUS announced an open-source domestic Jev cross-platform reproduction designed to deliver second-level decision outputs from Chinese models.（QbitAI） · Alibaba Wan shared creator examples emphasizing motion control and animation quality for its latest video-generation work.（X / Alibaba Wan） · Tripo built an interactive browser experience that turns a flat travel photo into a navigable 3D iPhone Duo presentation.（X / Tripo AI） · A Chinese report examined how AI is reshaping practical cybersecurity skills and how security teams must adapt to business deployments.（QbitAI） · Tripo highlighted a Smart UV feature in its P2.0 release, aimed at improving texture mapping for generated 3D assets.（X / Tripo AI） · The Exfiltrate Your Weights project published material focused on how model weights can be stolen from AI systems.（Exfiltrate Your Weights） · GitHub outlined evaluation practices for AI coding systems, warning that clean benchmark performance can miss cases that matter in real-world use.（X / GitHub）

item.title: ⚡ 15 quick hits — Evening edition, Sep 19
item.description: · OpenClaw released version 2026.9.5 with atomic updates, plugin hot reload, conversation sharing, and expanded GPT Live support.（MarkTechPost） · SiliconANGLE argued that AI governance must evolve from observing agent behavior toward proving that systems remain controllable.（SiliconANGLE） · Cohere highlighted Aston Martin F1 and Magnus Carlsen appearances at Canada’s largest AI conference in a post on X.（X / Cohere） · Flock reportedly offered employee buyouts as the AI-focused company looked to reduce its workforce.（TechCrunch） · Donald Trump said AI should be rebranded and announced plans for an AI Force, adding a new political label to federal AI efforts.（TechCrunch） · TypeSafe AI released Jev, a system model that returns typed, calibrated decisions instead of free-form text.（MarkTechPost） · AGNTCon Europe focused on preventing autonomous AI agents from causing catastrophic harm as agent deployment expands.（SiliconANGLE） · Salesforce’s post-Dreamforce strategy was discussed as an effort to grow beyond the company’s traditional CRM interface through AI.（SiliconANGLE） · Disney appointed former Character.AI chief executive Karandeep Anand as its first companywide chief technology officer to strengthen its AI strategy.（IT之家） · Petlibro introduced an AI-powered feeder designed to recognize individual cats and adapt feeding in multi-cat households.（TechCrunch） · The FAA will spend $875 million on an AI air-traffic-control system intended to address persistent aviation-management problems.（IT之家） · Unity launched official plugins for Claude Code and OpenAI Codex, supplying maintained skills for Unity 6 development workflows.（The Decoder） · A new safety benchmark found GPT-6 Astra and Claude Fable produced dangerous slapstick behaviors when controlling robot arms.（The Decoder） · Vals raised $40 million from Andreessen Horowitz to build private benchmarks measuring whether AI models complete complex professional tasks.（TechCrunch） · The Verge reported that US lawmakers’ fight over AI regulation remains unresolved amid disputes about federal and state authority.（The Verge）
